articles.title: Anthropic gains after IPO, but pulls off highest levels
articles.snippet: After opening at $111.50, ANT quickly slipped back under $100, still above its $83 offering price.

articles.title: Crypto traders vs. Wall Street: OKX’s Anthropic markets put IPO pricing to the test
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange plans to launch tokenized Anthropic shares as its pre-IPO futures trade about 24% above the company’s $83 offering price.

articles.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
articles.snippet: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
articles.snippet: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

articles.title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
articles.snippet: Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.
